title: The Bearish Trade That Blows Up When You're Actually Right
speaker: Tom Preston (TP) and Chris (tastylive hosts)

macro_themes.theme: Low VIX in a risk-on market
macro_themes.view: VIX near 15 reflects the collective judgment of the market; it could spike to 45-50 only briefly in a cataclysm or election selloff.

calls.reason: Hosts had been saying the market is going to go up; leaning more bullish into October has worked.
calls.quote: you just heard Chris and me talking about, well, gee whiz, the market's going to go up

calls.condition: In a cataclysm or Brexit-like election selloff the VIX could hit 45-50, very briefly.
calls.reason: TP holds small long VIX call spreads, losing daily; admits he does not know when VIX turns.
calls.quote: my little long call spread loses money every single day. Okay. Because I'm long the VIX.

notes: Viewer Q&A, mostly education (put verticals vs butterflies, trade logs).
